title: Combat rogue: Kick on a casting mob within 3 s of the cast start

rules.desc: The rogue casts Kick on the mob within 3 s of an interruptible cast start, at least 60 percent of the time (one trigger per mob per 10 s, one counted answer per 10 s: Kick's cooldown)
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/rogue/RogueStrategy.cpp:377-396 (RogueCcStrategy), :385-387 (kick at ACTION_INTERRUPT + 1); ai/playerbot/strategy/rogue/RogueTriggers.h:9; ai/playerbot/strategy/rogue/RogueActions.h:113-117 (CastKickAction is a CastMeleeInterruptSpellAction); ai/playerbot/AiFactory.cpp:876-892 (rogues get 'cc'); ai/playerbot/strategy/generic/ThreatStrategy.cpp:68-83 (the high-threat veto); ai/playerbot/AiFactory.cpp:633-642 (KeepsPartyThreatBackoff), :1007-1016 (non-tank bots under a real master get 'threat'); ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.cpp:1072-1075 (InterruptSpellTrigger); ai/playerbot/PlayerbotAISpells.cpp:1799-1847 (IsInterruptableSpellCasting); ai/playerbot/strategy/actions/GenericSpellActions.h:131-152 (CastInterruptSpellAction / CastMeleeInterruptSpellAction: 'interrupt target', still the CastSpellAction threat type), :39 (ACTION_THREAT_SINGLE); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: every rogue has the cc strategy and the kick row outranks the whole combo rotation, so with no threat back-off this passes. But CastKickAction is a CastMeleeInterruptSpellAction (RogueActions.h:113-117), which still inherits CastSpellAction's ACTION_THREAT_SINGLE (GenericSpellActions.h:39), and ThreatMultiplier scores every such action 0 while 'high threat' is active (ThreatStrategy.cpp:68-83). The rogue gets the threat strategy under a player tank (AiFactory.cpp:633-642,1007-1016) and its white swings keep it near 80 percent of a player tank with no gear, so Kick may be vetoed most of the fight. FAIL here with a PASS on the no-tank control would prove that. Kick only: the node's alternative Kidney Shot is not counted, because the events cannot show that it stopped the cast

rules.desc: Precondition: Defensive Stance (aura 71) stays on the player through the fight
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: setup check player_stance proves the stance at the start, this uptime proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the stance is cast in set-up and nothing in the fight removes it; a repeat where it drops shows here instead of passing silently
